description: This Java source file defines an abstract class 'InputMethodSettingsFragment' that extends Android's PreferenceFragment, providing a base class for input method (IME) settings UI components within the Android input method framework. It manages setting titles, icons, and updating subtype enablers for input method preferences.

classes.name: InputMethodSettingsFragment
classes.description: An abstract helper class for input method settings fragment, providing common setup and configuration methods for subclasses representing specific IME settings screens.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the preference screen and the input method settings.

methods.name: setInputMethodSettingsCategoryTitle
methods.description: Sets the title of the input method settings category by resource ID or CharSequence.

methods.name: setSubtypeEnablerTitle
methods.description: Sets the title of the subtype enabler by resource ID or CharSequence.

methods.name: setSubtypeEnablerIcon
methods.description: Sets the icon of the subtype enabler by resource ID or Drawable.

methods.name: onResume
methods.description: Updates subtype enabler when the fragment resumes.
